capabilities.title: Dashboard
capabilities.description: Security posture, sensor health, alerts, and performance overview.

capabilities.title: Threats
capabilities.description: High-severity and user-verified items from Windows events, hardening, firewall, and persistence findings, with mark-false-positive, dismiss, reopen, and copy. Response actions (remediate, quarantine, kill, block, isolate, auto-remediation), browser scan, and reports remain unported.

capabilities.title: Remediation
capabilities.description: Quarantine a user-selected file (encrypted, write-ahead journaled, verified before removal) and restore it with confirmation; per-request consent, caller check, audit log, and crash recovery. Alert-driven actions, process kill, firewall/USB blocks, and isolation (DN-008 phases 2-5) remain.

capabilities.title: Possible Threats
capabilities.description: Lower-severity items awaiting verification; Verify promotes to Threats, with dismiss and false-positive handling. (v29 never populated this list.) Intel lookup awaits DN-025.

capabilities.title: Processes
capabilities.description: Read-only live process inventory is available; lineage analysis and security signals remain to be ported.

capabilities.title: Drivers
capabilities.description: Every loaded kernel driver with its verified signer (embedded or catalog) and a verdict: known malicious or vulnerable (LOLDrivers hash), loaded from a user-writable folder, unsigned, or OK. Update, roll back and uninstall go through Windows' own tools until the elevated driver broker exists.

capabilities.title: Devices & Drivers
capabilities.description: Every Plug and Play device with its status, problem code explained in plain words with a fix, driver provider, version, date and signer; devices missing a driver; oldest drivers; and a read-only Windows Update driver search that shows which driver updates exist and which device each is for. Installing, rolling back, uninstalling and reinstalling are handed to Windows' own Optional updates page and Device Manager until the elevated driver broker with automatic backup and rollback is finished.

capabilities.title: Driver Packages
capabilities.description: Enumerates installed driver packages from the Windows Driver Store with INF file, version, class, provider, hardware IDs, and signature status.

capabilities.title: Network
capabilities.description: Live interface counters and bounded active TCP inventory are available; protocol events and detection remain unported.

capabilities.title: Security Events
capabilities.description: Read-only observations from fixed Windows event channels are available; event correlation, Sysmon/ETW sources, and detection workflows remain unported.

capabilities.title: Alerts
capabilities.description: Persistent deduplicated event-ID alerts with evidence references and local acknowledge/suppress triage state.

capabilities.title: File Inspector
capabilities.description: User-selected local PE static metadata and SHA-256 inspection, plus YARA scanning of a file or folder (optionally recursive) with the 179 bundled v29 rules on YARA-X 1.21.0 in an isolated job-limited helper. Matches from rules that stay quiet on clean Windows files go to triage; 108 noisy v29 rules are shown as low confidence only. No signature verification, reputation, or automatic remediation.

capabilities.title: Threat Intelligence
capabilities.description: Live read-only CISA KEV catalog with bounded ingestion, search, provenance, source freshness, and explicit one-CVE EPSS lookup. Multi-feed correlation remains planned; local name candidates are in Vulnerabilities.

capabilities.title: Threat Intel Feeds
capabilities.description: Searchable browser over every locally downloaded threat database (abuse.ch ThreatFox, URLhaus, MalwareBazaar, Feodo Tracker, Spamhaus, Emerging Threats, LOLDrivers, LOLBAS, phishing and stalkerware lists). Replaces the former per-click abuse.ch API calls, which now require a registered key; the deprecated SSL Blacklist feeds are no longer offered.

capabilities.title: Threat Databases
capabilities.description: 45 allow-listed public databases (LOLDrivers, LOLBAS, LOLRMM remote-access tools, abuse.ch, Spamhaus, attack-framework C2 lists, Signature-Base and Mandiant hashes, Pegasus and Predator spyware, HaGeZi, CERT Polska, ransomware, scam, cryptojacking and phishing lists, FireHOL, DShield, IPsum, CINS, GreenSnow, blocklist.de, Tor exits, stalkerware indicators, IPtoASN origin) downloaded whole over HTTPS, validated, cached, and matched locally against live connections with owning programs, the DNS cache, loaded kernel drivers, and running programs. Shows approximate country and network for every connection and offers offline lookups. Nothing about this PC is sent to any source; matches become triage findings and nothing is blocked automatically.

capabilities.title: CVE Dashboard
capabilities.description: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog related to this PC: Windows flaws published after the newest installed update (likely missing), installed apps matched by name, ransomware-used flaws, monthly and vendor charts, filters by scope and year, and per-CVE detail with CISA's required action and deadline, on-demand EPSS, and NVD and Microsoft advisories. Read-only; patches are installed through Windows Update.

capabilities.title: Vulnerabilities
capabilities.description: Installed application inventory with cautious CISA KEV product-name candidates and NVD/CVSS enrichment with affected-version analysis.

capabilities.title: Hardening
capabilities.description: 43 read-only checks with a hardening score: v29 firmware_posture and system_hardening checks plus NSA/CIS items (Defender settings, firewall, UAC, SmartScreen, driver blocklist, RDP, credential exposure such as WDigest/LM/NTLMv1, LLMNR/NetBIOS, SMB signing, PrintNightmare, update age and Windows lifecycle). Each finding has fix steps and opens the right Windows Security or Settings page. One-click fix waits for the audited elevated broker.

capabilities.title: Performance
capabilities.description: Live CPU, physical-memory, system-commit, OS-volume, active-adapter, and physical-disk throughput gauges; two-minute CPU/memory/commit/network/disk history; per-process CPU in the bounded process inventory; process/thread and TCP counts; uptime; volume space; largest working sets; bounded CSV export. Per-core CPU, pagefile storage usage, GPU, thermals, and power remain unported.

capabilities.title: Ransomware
capabilities.description: Ransomware early warning and file resilience: real-time decoy canary file monitoring, protected directory posture, Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) anti-recovery detection, and passive entropy disruption analysis. Automated rollback guarded pending action broker (DN-008).

capabilities.title: Firewall
capabilities.description: Read-only profiles, rules with Downpour-rule identification, tamper findings (service stopped, profile off, risky inbound allows), and recent Event 5157 blocked connections. Rule toggle/delete, remove-all-Downpour-rules, and new-rule baseline alerts remain unported.

capabilities.title: Wi-Fi
capabilities.description: Read-only wireless posture: visible networks, Evil Twin detection, weak authentication (Open/WEP), attack tool OUIs, and paired Bluetooth device history. Radio disabling, interface disconnect, and deauth defense remain unported.

capabilities.title: DNS
capabilities.description: Read-only resolver cache inspection with Shannon entropy, consonant/digit ratios, bigram frequency scoring, risky TLD weighting, TOFU baseline, and passive SPF/DMARC/DKIM email record analysis. Cache clearing, hosts file editing, and active DNS tunneling defense remain unported.

capabilities.title: Project AEGIS
capabilities.description: Five-layer AEGIS protection architecture overview with fully local, zero-trust Layer 4 NLP phishing and social engineering text analyzer.

capabilities.title: Memory
capabilities.description: Memory forensics and process injection detection: running process memory review, process hollowing detection (T1055.012), path masquerading analysis (T1036), core binary location validation, thread hijacking and injection scoring (0-100), and auto-monitoring. Process termination guarded pending action broker (DN-008).

capabilities.title: Forensics
capabilities.description: Digital evidence collection with cryptographic SHA-256 chain of custody, security alert correlation, event logs, persistence anomalies, blocked connections, legal HTML incident reports, raw JSON bundle export, and FBI IC3 filing integration. Strictly read-only.

capabilities.title: Threat Hunt
capabilities.description: Persistence review: Run/RunOnce (incl. WOW64), Winlogon, startup folders, scheduled tasks incl. hidden, WMI subscriptions, DLL shadows in user-writable PATH folders, and driver files with BYOVD names, against a hash-only TOFU baseline. v29 hunt modes, LOLBin/process hunts, and response actions remain unported.

capabilities.title: Sandbox
capabilities.description: Safe file sandbox and static artifact analysis: Shannon entropy calculation, cryptographic checksums (SHA-256/SHA-1/MD5), PE structure and W^X violation detection, known packer identification, and Win32 API string pattern scoring (injection, evasion, spyware, C2). Host detonation disabled under least-privilege policy.

capabilities.title: Services
capabilities.description: Read-only Windows service inventory with current state and startup configuration.

capabilities.title: USB Devices
capabilities.description: Read-only USB device posture: removable drive inventory, autorun detection, device history (USBSTOR/USB), and BadUSB/attack tool hardware signatures. Device blocking, write protection, and autorun neutralizing remain unported.

capabilities.title: IoT Devices
capabilities.description: Local subnet device discovery via ARP, MAC OUI vendor fingerprinting, IoT device categorization, and Mozi/Mirai/Kimwolf botnet indicator detection. Device blocking guarded under DN-008.

capabilities.title: Timeline
capabilities.description: Correlated and standalone security event timeline with automated attack pattern detection (brute force, persistence, account manipulation, service installs) and dark-themed executive HTML report export.

capabilities.title: Anti-Stalker
capabilities.description: Detects and logs anything that can watch or control this PC: per-app camera, microphone, screen-capture, and location use from Windows usage records (including in-use-now), Remote Desktop sessions with client name and address, remote-control programs, and installed or running spyware, keyloggers, and employee or parental monitoring software. A local watch log records every start and stop. Read-only; nothing leaves the PC.

capabilities.title: Audio Shield
capabilities.description: Every second: which programs are receiving microphone or loopback (everything you hear) audio with live levels, owner, path and signature; every playback and recording device with kind (built-in, USB, Bluetooth, virtual, loopback, remote), format, volume, mute and newly appeared devices; audio effect DLLs (APOs) loaded into audiodg.exe with signature checks; audio engine location, signature and CPU; Windows Audio services; microphone privacy settings; and audio error counts. Explains glitch causes (stopped services, overloaded engine, Bluetooth hands-free mode, muted output). Fixes run through the audited action broker (end program, quarantine) or open the exact Windows settings page. Never opens a microphone or reads audio.

capabilities.title: Remote Access
capabilities.description: Read-only Remote Desktop state (enabled, NLA, port), TCP listeners and connections on v29 remote-access vector ports with owning processes, and running remote-access tools; high-confidence findings feed triage. Block-IP and vector hardening actions remain unported.

capabilities.title: Cleanup
capabilities.description: Read-only system and disk cleanup inspector: temporary directories (%TEMP%, Windows\Temp), WER error reports, thumbnail cache, crash dumps, Windows Update caches, and Recycle Bin space analysis with executive report export. Deletion actions disabled pending action broker (DN-008).

capabilities.title: VPN
capabilities.description: VPN interface posture, DNS split-tunnel leak assessment, known provider identification, TCP egress connectivity probes, and OpenVPN profile parsing. Firewall kill-switch guarded under DN-008.

capabilities.title: Parental Controls
capabilities.description: Family safety posture: screen time scheduling, bedtime curfew monitoring, web category filtering, hosts DNS blocklist review, and application restriction posture.

capabilities.title: Emergency Response
capabilities.description: Rapid incident containment: one-click emergency lockdown, point-in-time forensic snapshots, suspicious process screening, and guarded network isolation under DN-008.

capabilities.title: Defense Suite
capabilities.description: Executive Defense Suite: unified posture aggregation, attack surface exposure scoring, core pillar status (AEGIS, Ransomware, Hardening, Emergency), and native read-only MITRE ATT&CK watcher diagnostics.

capabilities.title: Tools
capabilities.description: Operations & Tools Launchpad: rapid launcher and operational telemetry for 9 security subsystems (Remote Access, VPN, Parental Controls, Emergency, Cleanup, USB, IoT, Services, Settings) and host system diagnostics.

capabilities.title: Settings
capabilities.description: Local appearance/notification preferences, explicit PowerShell-content and intel-lookup settings, encrypted API-key management, and actual quarantine/process/firewall/USB broker-policy switches. Per-request confirmation and Windows permissions still apply; automatic elevation remains unfinished.

capabilities.title: Cognitive Immune System
capabilities.description: Measured review of validated local alert/system snapshots, source-health warnings, per-request action policy, cautious temporal correlations, and explicit bounded package-file SHA-256 checks against an unsigned local release manifest. No synthetic protection scores or autonomous response. Full adaptive/deception CIS parity remains unfinished.
